top_choice_rationale: P002 (Calvo, Taylor, Woodford) is the largest and most durable scientific contribution on the slate. Nominal rigidity and rule-based policy are the organising structure of modern monetary analysis in academia and central banks. The three credited steps are dated and separable: Calvo's tractable time-dependent pricing, Taylor's staggered contracts and policy rule, and Woodford's welfare-based synthesis. I rank it first only if the citation is confined to the theory of nominal rigidities and policy rules, as P002 is worded. It should not claim that the simple model performed well in 2008 or 2021-23, and it should not claim the estimation work. I accept the real costs. Gali, Gertler, Christiano, Eichenbaum and Smets are omitted, the trio spans about four decades, and Calvo pricing is a device with mixed micro support. That the framework survived and adapted is weaker evidence for the specific credited building blocks than for the framework as a whole. P001 (Helpman, Melitz) is a very close second. It has a cleaner credit set and more direct microdata testing of the selection and reallocation mechanism. It carries an open question about Bernard, Eaton, Jensen and Kortum, and the 2008 trade prize needs the same distinctness test I apply to P002. The ordering of P002 and P001 rests on weighting breadth and durability of influence above attribution clarity, and I hold it with limited confidence. P004 has the cleanest attribution but thinner direct identification of the collateral channel and some thematic overlap with the 2022 prize. P003 has strong local-labour-market identification but a contested boundary between its two strands and contested persistence of the estimates. All four are credible achievements and rank above no award.
recusal_note: I am a long-standing co-author and IIES colleague of John Hassler (chair), who also ranks P002 first, so I do not count his agreement as independent evidence. I have also co-authored with Timo Boppart (co-opted member), who prefers P001. My heterogeneous-agent macro field is adjacent to the critique of the representative-agent framework in P002. My profile lists no tie to Woodford, Taylor, Calvo, Helpman, Melitz, Kiyotaki, Moore, Autor, Dorn or Hanson. These ties are disclosed and not adjudicated, and I completed the ballot.
